verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents employer-side H-1B work as a service. Its H-1B page covers guided intake of company, role and candidate details, organizes employer and candidate materials in one workflow, and offers to "manage transfers and extensions". Enterprise and startup pages target hiring teams and first-time sponsoring companies, and the fee calculator accounts for employer-specific fees such as the 50/50 rule. Missing for 10: any mention of H-1B cap registration/lottery handling, any mention of LCA preparation or compliance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the employer-sponsor service.
